title: Padma Lakshmi Marks Diwali With Mother Home From Hospital and New CBS Show
excerpt: In an Instagram post reported by IANS, Padma Lakshmi said her mother came home after months in hospital, as the family kept Diwali low-key and celebrated her seventh book and a new CBS show.
body:
• Padma Lakshmi said this year's Diwali was special because her mother returned home from the hospital after several months and is gradually getting back to being herself, IANS reported on November 10.
  • In an Instagram post sharing two pictures, Lakshmi said the family did a pared-down, low-key Diwali with a much smaller number of family and friends.
  • She listed work milestones among the reasons to celebrate, including her seventh book and creating a new show for CBS, as well as a new endeavour for her daughter Krishna.
  • For diaspora readers, the post is a family update only in Lakshmi's own words: she reported her mother is back to being, in her phrase, mostly herself, and gave no further medical details.

India-born model and television personality Padma Lakshmi said this year's Diwali celebrations were special as her mother returned home from the hospital after several months and was gradually getting back to being herself. The festivities also marked several milestones, including her seventh book and the creation of a new show, IANS reported from Mumbai on November 10.

What Lakshmi posted

Lakshmi took to Instagram, where she shared two pictures. In the first she is seen posing with her daughter Krishna, and the other featured her mother, according to IANS.

"We did a pared down and low key Divali this year with a much smaller number of family and friends. But there was still so much to celebrate including mama Lakshmi coming home from the hospital after months — and I'm glad to report she is back to being (mostly) herself."

— Padma Lakshmi, in her Instagram caption, as reported by IANS

Lakshmi gave no further details about her mother's hospital stay in the post as reported, and this article reports only what she herself shared: that her mother had been in hospital for months, is now home, and is gradually returning to herself.

Work milestones in the same post

Lakshmi also spoke about her daughter Krishna's new endeavour, without describing it yet. In the same caption she listed her own work among the celebrations.

"We also celebrated successful work projects for me like my 7th book and creating the new show for cbs, as well as a new endeavor for Krishna (more on that later!), and of course that light prevailed over darkness with the midterm results."

— Padma Lakshmi, in her Instagram caption, as reported by IANS

The CBS project she referred to has been reported separately. Parade reported that Lakshmi created the new food series for CBS and will executive produce it alongside former NBCUniversal content chief Susan Rovner, and that, according to The Hollywood Reporter, the show under the working title America's Culinary Cup will feature the nation's most decorated chefs competing in a format designed to challenge their creativity, endurance, presentation and leadership. Lakshmi's Diwali post did not name the show or give a premiere date.

Who she is

Born in India, Lakshmi immigrated to the United States as a child. She became a model before embarking on a career on television and rose to prominence by hosting Top Chef, according to IANS. She is the creator, host and executive producer of the docuseries Taste the Nation with Padma Lakshmi, and has received 16 Primetime Emmy Award nominations. IANS also reported that at age 36 she was diagnosed with endometriosis, which she has had since early adolescence, and that in 2022 she was honoured by the Carnegie Corporation of New York's Great Immigrant Award.

She closed her Diwali caption, as reported by IANS, with a wish that Diwali keeps ushering in peace and light for all. For diaspora families marking a quieter festival this year because a parent is recovering at home, her post offered a recognisable version of the holiday: smaller, at home, and centred on family being together again.

Family gathering was low-key with fewer guests.
